name: kaspersky_edr
label: Kaspersky EDR
desc: Kaspersky EDR (Threat Response) integration. Perform EDR response actions on endpoints managed by Kaspersky Security Center (KSC): isolate a host, prevent execution of a file, quarantine or delete a file, retrieve a file, terminate a process, start a process, run an IOC scan, and run a malware scan. Actions are delivered via the KSC Open API HostGroup.AddIncident method over direct HTTPS/JSON. Authentication is via a KSC user account (session-based).
